name: punyts
description: The development workspace for the punyts system: each library is its own repo, cloned here by bin/workspace.mjs

scripts.setup: node bin/workspace.mjs clone && npm install && npm run build && npx playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell
scripts.build: node bin/workspace.mjs run build && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
scripts.mcp:build: node bin/workspace.mjs run build core expression state state-sync statenet stateui stateui-3d stateui-app stateui-components stateui-mcp && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
scripts.magnetic:build: node bin/workspace.mjs run build core expression state state-sync stateui stateui-3d stateui-app stateui-components stateui-mcp stateui-pg magnetic && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
scripts.ui:build: node bin/workspace.mjs run build stateui stateui-app stateui-components stateui-mcp stateui-pg magnetic && npm run build:runtime-bundle -w @punyts/stateui-app
scripts.magnetic:dev: npm run ui:build && npm run magnetic
